title: Named-root operator routes lack HTTP-level tests (request shape, unknown fields, error mapping)
outcome: Named-root operator routes lack HTTP-level tests (request shape, unknown fields, error mapping)
acceptance: Router-level tests cover the GET rows' JSON shape and the POST release's 200, 400 (blank reason), 409 (live claim, changed selection), 422 (unknown field) and 500 (unconfirmed persistence) responses.
